summary: Energy Fuels filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting an at-the-market prospectus supplement for up to $500 million of common shares under its June 13, 2025 Controlled Equity Offering sales agreement with BMO, Canaccord, Cantor, B. Riley, and H.C. Wainwright. Approximately $300 million had already been sold under the prior supplement. Dentons provided the Ontario legal opinion. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; there are no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock. Watch the pace of ATM sales and any dilution overhang on UUUU.
